notes.title: Announcing an alpha version of Open Fishing: AFK Edition
notes.notes:
I've made a small game which is basically Open Fishing XL but as a board game. It doesn't exactly have a board but there isn't really a better word for the kind of game it is. It's just a series of text and pdf documents at the moment but it's really fun and vibes very similarly to the Open Fishing XL.

[h1]Here's an image of the rules:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276303/d583fc774e80ad11a57dd17c9116fe27d2fff1d0.png[/img]

[h1]Join the Discord to get the full rules[/h1]
[url=https://discord.gg/J9zgfmzrhH]Click Here To Join![/url]

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Systems made to be played while hiking, fishing or doing other fun things outside!
[*] Spoiler free since fish are in different areas than in Open Fishing XL.
[*] A unique fishing system
[*] 25+ fish already in game
[*] Mod support!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=7b__J9-PMSE;full][/previewyoutube]

Process to return to old graphics:
[olist]
[*] Open the properties by right clicking on Open Fishing XL in your steam library
[*] Go to betas and select the Old Graphics beta from the drop down.
[*] Now update and boot the game and graphics should return to normal!

notes.title: Update 1.1 is OUT, Better controller support and more gameplay options.
notes.notes:
Howdy, here's a post launch patch to solve some issues, improve the steam deck experience, and add some small things.

There is no longer a button in the settings menu to switch to controller mode, this now happens automatically. This was a whole ordeal to get working, having to move to the new unity input system (which I despise lol). There's currently a minor bug where the camera snaps to your mouse when switching back and forth. Not a huge deal but it's something I'm aware of. If this is a big deal to any of you please tell me, I might go back and fix it.

I've also added insta fish mode, in this mode there's no reeling in. I've added this for those that can't click fast for whatever reason or those that want an even more relaxed experience. You will not be added to the leaderboard when using this mode. Insta fish mode can be enabled in the settings menu.

Also fairy lights have been added, I think they look really cute and help to distance the game from the ps1 horror aesthetics. I've also added other stuff but that's all in the change log.

Changelog:
Added a locked-more visible fish meter, enableable in the settings
Added a cheat for the map screen for those who don't want to draw the whole thing
Added insta fish mode
Added fairy lights
Changed to the new input system
Fixed the FOV issue some player had on the rogue isle
Fixed controller support in the net catch screen

notes.title: Oops, Here's a patch to fix a bug I missed (update 8.6).
notes.notes:
So I am essentially just fixing the fact that the tooltips saying when you can sell a certain crops were one day off the actual day of the week because of a bug I missed. The days of the week in C# start on Sunday but I assumed that they would start on Monday this resulted in all the tooltips being wrong, OOPS.

Sorry for all the small patches, because of the rapid update schedule I tend to miss stuff like this from time to time.

(The menu will still say update 8.5, don't worry about that you are on the new patch most likely.)

[list]
[*] Changed the days on which crops are sold to match tooltips.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 7 is out! New fishing mechanics, rods and more!
notes.notes:
Update 7 is here! This one took a long time (for me at least) but it's a big one. New types of fishing, overhauled fishing mechanics and finally rod upgrades! You can now buy compasses with unique looks and boots to let you wade deeper. Spinning real fishing is new but will get more attention later on to make it more unique however it's a nice bit of variety. The new fishing mechanics were suggested by someone on discord and make the fishing much more engaging and fun however I would love more feedback as usual. Now the fish moves side to side and that effects the movement of the icon on the bar making fishing more challenging on bigger fish or with lighter rods. Next one should be done a bit quicker.
